issues.description: Method name mismatch for the 3-qubit QFT routine: the template defines a protected-style method named `_qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit)` while the solution implements a public method `qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit)`. The problem statement's exercise (Exercise 6.1) asks students to implement the QFT but does not document a leading-underscore name; automated tests and example solution refer to `qft_circuit`. This naming inconsistency can confuse students about which method to implement and may cause automated graders or imported example code to fail to find the expected public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the public API name consistent across template, solution, and tests. Rename the template method `_qft_circuit` to `qft_circuit(self, qc: QuantumCircuit)` (remove the leading underscore) so students implement the public method expected by tests and the solution, or add a public `qft_circuit` wrapper in the template that calls the existing `_qft_circuit`. Update any tests or documentation to reference the chosen name.
